summary.text: Bradley Barrett is a Republican who has represented Kansas House District 76 in Osage County since 2025.
He is vice chair of the Corrections and Juvenile Justice Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Kansas Legislature profile, Barrett's occupation is special investigator for the Shawnee County District Attorney, and his spouse is Sarah Barrett.
He also serves on the Judiciary and Legislative Modernization committees, the Joint Committee on Kansas Security and the Russ Jennings Joint Committee on Corrections and Juvenile Justice Oversight.
